movies.title: The Passenger
movies.overview: Hassan, a Somali-American airport shuttle driver in Minneapolis, is struggling to make ends meet. When Lloyd, a stranded twenty-something at the airport, offers to pay Hassan to take him overland to Chicago, it seems worth the risk. But as the realization grows that his passenger is not what he seems, Hassan finds himself trapped in a terrifying ride that he can’t escape, knowing that saving himself might put countless others in danger.
movies.tagline: No way out. No way back.

episodes.title: Mason's Rats

episodes.title: In Vaulted Halls Entombed

episodes.title: Can't Stop
episodes.overview: Turn up your stereo and tune into a Red Hot Chili Peppers concert that's unlike any other — with a few strings attached.

episodes.title: Close Encounters of the Mini Kind
episodes.overview: They came in peace. But when their first encounter with Earthlings goes awry, these extra-tiny extraterrestrials are ready for vengeance.

episodes.title: Spider Rose
episodes.overview: At the edge of the galaxy, a grieving woman dreams of revenge. Can an adorable newcomer help her destroy her enemies — without destroying her humanity?

episodes.title: 400 Boys
episodes.overview: Are they gods? Are they giants? All this band of survivors knows is that they're deadly — and they'll have to set aside their own turf war to stop them.

episodes.title: The Other Large Thing
episodes.overview: This furry revolutionary has plans for world domination. All he needs is a henchman with opposable thumbs.

episodes.title: Golgotha
episodes.overview: A mysterious race of aquatic aliens has arrived on Earth. They don't want to be taken to our leaders.

episodes.title: The Screaming of the Tyrannosaur
episodes.overview: In an orbital arena, gladiators and dinosaurs compete in a deadly race — and face a terrifying new opponent.

episodes.title: How Zeke Got Religion
episodes.overview: On a perilous mission into hostile territory, the crew of a World War II bomber encounters an unholy enemy.

episodes.title: Smart Appliances, Stupid Owners
episodes.overview: From thermostats to toothbrushes to toilets, these ultra-modern appliances have something to say about their hapless owners.

episodes.title: For He Can Creep
episodes.overview: London, 1757. Satan battles a cat for the soul of a poet whose verse could give him dominion over the earth.

movies.title: Mutiny
movies.overview: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

movies.title: Lanterns
movies.overview: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.
movies.tagline: Only one can wear the ring.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.overview: After a fatal shooting, Green Lantern Hal Jordan and new recruit John Stewart set out to prove it was an extraterrestrial event.

episodes.title: Trust Fall
episodes.overview: While John's middling errand ultimately proves eventful, Hal makes waves in Rushville – which only inspires him to dig deeper.

episodes.title: OutKast
episodes.overview: When his dad misunderstands a contact attempt from the Guardians, John is put forth as the next best option to fulfill the Green Lantern destiny. Then, after a lifetime of preparation, John finally gets his chance to interview for the Guardians.

episodes.title: The Weenie
episodes.overview: As the 48-hour deadline nears, John develops a new theory about the Manhunter's location, leading him and Hal to run their next move by Sheriff Kane. Meanwhile, Hal's visit to Sinestro has consequences.

episodes.title: Lights Out
episodes.overview: As the Macon family's history unravels, Rushville mobilizes in the face of the escalating threat. As John is placed in an impossible position, Hal risks everything in a final attempt to take down the Manhunter.

episodes.title: Bad Optics
episodes.overview: Now in business with his brother Marcus, John is on the verge of landing a major investor for his innovative take on panic rooms when an unexpected phone call pulls him back to Rushville - and everything he worked so hard to leave behind.

episodes.title: The Jordan Boys' Legacy
episodes.overview: Finding themselves on another planet, Hal and John must put aside their fractured past to solve a murder. Along their journey, both men are forced to confront the ghosts of their pasts...and the ways their childhoods shaped who they are today.

movies.title: Runner
movies.overview: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

movies.title: The Runner
movies.overview: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.
movies.tagline: One hour. One chance to save her son.

movies.title: Resident Evil
movies.overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

movies.title: UNABOMBER
movies.overview: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.
movies.tagline: Where brilliance ends, the madness begins.

movies.title: Heart of the Beast
movies.overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

movies.title: Digger
movies.overview: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.
movies.tagline: A man. A plan. A meltdown.

movies.title: The Love Hypothesis
movies.overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

movies.title: Toy Story 5
movies.overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
movies.tagline: A brand new day starts now.

movies.title: The End of Oak Street
movies.overview: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

movies.title: Coyote vs. Acme
movies.overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.
movies.tagline: The movie ACME doesn't want you to see.

movies.title: Backrooms
movies.overview: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

movies.title: Idiots
movies.overview: Two rock-bottom drivers transport a wealthy teen to rehab, but their simple job spirals into a chaotic journey of drugs, danger, and crime as their passenger derails their plans.

cast.name: Nicholas Braun
cast.character: Joe Thom Pell Aka Pricka Bush Da Werewoof

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.
movies.tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.

movies.title: Inception
movies.overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.
movies.tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.

movies.title: Dune: Part Two
movies.overview: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, Paul endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

movies.title: Oppenheimer
movies.overview: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer's role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II.
